summary: src/http.ts now resolves generic wildcard and local-network clients through resolveClient when deciding CORS origins, and tests/bun_test.ts covers an unregistered wildcard preflight and a local HTTP origin while the managed registry is empty, plus continued denial after a wildcard client is deleted. The change is consistent with the handler client-resolution policy and introduces no actionable defect.

evidence: src/http.ts knownCorsOrigin now derives the candidate client id from the origin hostname first label and calls resolveClient with effective wildcard domains, registered clients and deleted client ids, granting the normalized origin when clientAllowsOrigin accepts the generic client.

tests/bun_test.ts asserts a preflight from an unregistered wildcard origin is allowed while effectiveClients is empty, and the local-network loop iteration asserts http://192.168.1.2:5173 is allowed with an empty registry.
tests/bun_test.ts also asserts the deleted wildcard client keeps receiving no CORS origin, while the local http development origin exception in clientAllowsOrigin remains intact.
